name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: People in comments, assignees, and member lists.

motionProfile.reason: Avatar coordinates an avatar group's presence and membership extent while each avatar owns its own size, retained image paint, changed text and scoped palette.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: Avatar integrates the avatar, badge, group and later count-tile entrances plus the current retained image paint; Base UI availability and caller media keep their native owners.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: Avatar fades a retained avatar, badge, group or count tile on its original host without cloning children or their resources.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: Avatar owns an explicit size change and AvatarGroup owns the membership-driven extent; image decode and parent constraints stay native.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: Avatar replaces changed runs in plain fallback initials, badge copy and count labels; rich caller children keep their own owners.

number.roll/reels.reason: Avatar reels a direct numeric count value on the count display; formatted strings and identity numbers remain text.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Avatar owns the fallback, badge and count surface-foreground palette it paints; the transparent root and caller-composed controls keep their own owners.
